policy: Preserve release/evidence; do not republish. October25 is mixed exposure, not a full post-release period. Define equal dated periods and reporting timezone, excluding the mixed day for whole-day comparisons. No small-sample outcome conclusion.

definitions.searchVisits: Search Console clicks and Analytics organic sessions are distinct measures, with date/coverage differences; not unique inquiries.
definitions.quoteInteractions: Form starts, phone clicks and calendar opens are intent, not submitted inquiries or issued quotes.
definitions.savedSubmissions: Accepted saved records require duplicate/test/spam/recruitment exclusions before genuine inquiry classification; Analytics acceptance events are not a substitute.
definitions.issuedQuotes: UNKNOWN until supported by actual quote records
definitions.paidWork: UNKNOWN until supported by payment/invoice records

privacy: Private Analytics/Firestore aggregate findings remain outside public repository; no new aggregate polling/index/tracking change for this candidate.
